purpose: Illustrative concepts, not completed ALQA client projects

prompts.name: social
prompts.prompt: Create one polished standalone illustrative concept image for a Doha creative agency website. Palette: Qatar maroon, cream, sand, restrained black. Editorial art direction, convincing materials, warm light. No ALQA logo, no client names, no watermark, no readable text. Landscape 3:2. Distinct complete scene, not a collage sheet. Overhead flat lay of a smartphone showing a beautiful nine-tile lifestyle social-media grid, several square designed social content cards arranged around it, cosmetic and fitness lifestyle imagery in the cards, maroon and cream graphic shapes, content planning notebook and pen. Modern social media campaign art direction, authentic print and screen textures.
